job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain large-scale software applications using Java/Node.js/React.js.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify requirements and implement solutions that meet business needs.
Ensure high-quality code by following coding standards, best practices, and testing methodologies.
Troubleshoot issues related to application performance, scalability, and reliability.

Job Requirements :

5-10 years of experience in full stack development with expertise in artificial intelligence (AIML), retrieval augmented generation (RAG).
Strong understanding of Kubernetes, Kafka, AWS services for deployment and management of applications.
Experience working on large language models such as AI-powered chatbots or virtual assistants.
